Black.general_guidance: High clay content with deep cracking and high moisture retention. Well suited for cotton and rabi crops. Requires controlled drainage to prevent waterlogging.

Red.general_guidance: Porous and friable with high aeration. Lower in natural organic matter, nitrogen, and phosphorus; responds exceptionally well to organic compost and balanced NPK.

Sandy.general_guidance: High drainage rate and low water holding capacity. Quick to warm up in summer. Drip irrigation and split fertilizer doses are recommended to avoid leaching.

Clayey.general_guidance: Dense heavy soil with high nutrient and water holding capacity. Excellent for submerged paddy wetlands; requires careful tillage when moisture is optimal.

Loamy.general_guidance: Ideal balanced agricultural soil with good drainage, aeration, and moisture retention. Highly versatile for multi-crop intensive rotations.
